title: Developer Experience Improvements - BigQuery Connector Feedback

features.title: Reserved Keywords Documentation & Error Messages
features.description: Document all 43 reserved keywords and improve parser error messages to help developers recognize and resolve keyword conflicts early.
acceptance_criteria: All 43 keywords documented in reference doc
Parser error message: 'Cannot use reserved keyword X as identifier'
Keyword error test cases passing
Documentation links properly in SUMMARY.md
No regressions in existing error handling

features.title: Module Import Transitivity Documentation
features.description: Document AILANG's explicit import design (imports are not transitive) and improve error messages to guide developers.
acceptance_criteria: Import transitivity design clearly documented
Example showing implicit vs. explicit imports
Error message mentions missing import with suggestion
Teaching prompt includes module pattern
All existing module tests still pass

features.title: Teaching Prompt Update for Reserved Keywords & Patterns
features.description: Update teaching prompt to include information about reserved keywords, module imports, and common patterns discovered from real-world usage.
acceptance_criteria: Teaching prompt includes reserved keywords section
Real-world examples from BigQuery connector
Module import rules explained
All syntax examples valid and tested

features.title: Fix Option Pattern Matching (CRITICAL)
features.description: Debug and fix pattern matching elaboration for ADT constructors (Option/Some/None). This is the highest-priority runtime fix as it affects core language feature.
acceptance_criteria: match Some(1) { Some(x) => x, None => 0 } works and returns 1
match None { Some(x) => x, None => 0 } returns 0
Nested ADT patterns work
Error messages include location info
All new tests passing
No regression in existing pattern matching tests
features.notes: CRITICAL PATH - highest priority. If takes longer than estimated, defer M2.4

features.title: Debug & Resolve Stdlib Version Mismatch (CRITICAL)
features.description: Investigate stdlib version mismatch warnings and determine if they indicate real problems. Either relax version checking for development or fix the root cause affecting Option patterns.
acceptance_criteria: Version mismatch warning either resolved or clearly explained
Investigation documented in commit message
If flag added, documented in ailang run --help
No false warnings in normal development workflow
Test for version handling
features.notes: May be related to Option pattern matching issue. Investigate together.

features.title: Enable If-Then-Else Block Expressions
features.description: Allow block expressions (with let bindings) in if-then-else branches to reduce boilerplate for multi-statement conditions.
acceptance_criteria: if condition then { let x = foo(); doSomething(x) } else ... works
Block expressions type-check correctly
Nested blocks work
All new tests passing
No regressions in existing if-then-else tests

features.title: Improve Record Type Inference in ADT Constructor Contexts
features.description: Allow record literals in ADT constructor arguments to benefit from type information (e.g., Ok({ field: value }) without intermediate binding).
acceptance_criteria: let _: Result[{a: int}, str] = Ok({ a: 1 }) works without intermediate binding
Type inference error messages suggest intermediate binding workaround
Nested records work
All new tests passing
No regressions in record or ADT tests
features.notes: Deferred if M2_1 takes longer than estimated. Non-critical but high-value.
